title: How can I remove attach to measure without removing the measure?
content:
I have accidentally attached the wrong garment pieces to my measure on avatar. I want to remove the attachment from these parts and attach the correct parts to the waist measure. The only way I see do this is by making a cut on all the incorrect pieces or deleting the measure. Surely there is a way to select the attached part and unattach it?

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi There! You can use the same tool to detach. 🙂Use the Attach to Measure (Avatar) Tool on the 3D tool bar > R-Click on the line or edge you want to detach in the 3D Window > Select the Detach option you need from the drop down

Comment 2: can you pls upload a image of your problem here?
content_description: This webpage aims to provide step-by-step guidance on how to detach incorrectly attached garment pieces from your avatar's measurements and correctly reattach the appropriate parts.
